value.name: Miles meets Joe at clam house
value.description: Miles sits across from gangster Joe in a seedy clam house to conduct a clandestine business meeting.
evidence: Miles seated across from Joe at a small round table in a seedy, low-lit clam house.

value.name: Miles claims to represent Dumbarton
value.description: Miles tells Joe he is representing Mr. Dumbarton on a delicate matter.
evidence: Miles says, 'I am here representing Mr. Dumbarton, on a... matter of some delicacy.'

value.name: Joe asks who the target is
value.description: Joe immediately identifies the meeting as a murder-for-hire discussion and asks who Miles wants killed.
evidence: Joe clarifies, 'Who do you want me to kill?'

value.name: Miles names Marilyn as target
value.description: After stumbling over his words, Miles identifies Marylin Rexroth Doyle Massey as the person to be neutralized.
evidence: Miles stammers, 'Well -- I, uh, that is to say Mr. Dumbarton -- would like you to uh, neutralize a, uh, business associate by the name of Marylin Rexroth Doyle Massey uh Dumbart -- uh, Massey.'

value.name: Joe confirms target identity
value.description: Joe checks whether Miles is referring to one person, underscoring the confusion around the target's name.

value.name: Miles provides target photo and address
value.description: Miles slides Joe an envelope containing the target's picture and the address where she is staying.
evidence: Miles pushes an envelope across the table: 'Here's her picture... and the address where she's staying.'

value.name: Miles sets expedited deadline
value.description: Miles explains that the killing must happen quickly because of an impending legal action.
evidence: 'And because of an impending legal action this needs to happen within a certain... time frame. Uh... on an expedited basis.'

value.name: Joe notes the rush
value.description: Joe reacts to the deadline by observing that Miles is in a hurry.

value.name: Miles confirms Dumbarton is rushing
value.description: Miles admits that Mr. Dumbarton wants the job done quickly.

value.name: Miles demands painless death
value.description: Miles anxiously asks whether the victim will suffer, revealing his fear and conscience.
evidence: Miles explodes: 'She won't suffer, will she?'

value.name: Joe demands extra payment for painless death
value.description: Joe agrees that the killing can be painless only if Miles pays more.
